title: Explicit inverse-image open comparison preserving units and restrictions
statement: Assume derived module categories on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let g′:X′→X and f′:X′→S′ be arbitrary scheme morphisms. For an open W of X let j′W:(g′⁻¹W)→X′ and pW:pullback(g′,W.ι)→X′ be the first projection [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product]. Fix the pinned pullback adjunctions and comparisons [def-pc-relative-mv-maps, lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and exact-open adjunctions [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components]. Define qW:Rj′W rW→RpW LpW by left-adjoint uniqueness rW≅Lj′W followed by transport through sW=pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict g′ W. For s:B≅A, j:A→X′, p:B→X′ and h:s.hom≫j=p this transport is Rj of the invertible s-unit at LjK′, then Rs followed by Rj applied to the component of Ls Lj≅Lp, then right-adjoint uniqueness from the transported composite adjunction to Lp⊣Rp. Define eW=Rf′(qW) followed by relativeMVImageComp pW f′. Then eW carries Rf′ of the exact W-unit to relativeMVUnit pW f′ K′. For every W≤U it intertwines Rf′ of the exact restriction along the inverse-image inclusion with relativeMVRestriction(relativeMVOpenLift g′ i,pU,pW,pullback.lift_fst,f′,K′). There is no cartesian-square, source object, coefficient map, cover, flatness or quasi-coherence hypothesis.

proof.text: The composition comparisons and identity comparisons identify pullback along a scheme isomorphism and its inverse as inverse functors. Thus its pullback is fully faithful, and Mathlib Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful makes its adjunction unit invertible. This argument is a proved helper, not an existence witness for data.

Construct the transport and qW and eW by the displayed compositions of actual isomorphisms. The projection-preserving scheme isomorphism supplies h. The composite-adjunction unit formula, unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app prove preservation of the units.

For arbitrary adjunctions and a comparison LU followed by H to LW, naturality and the U triangle identity show that the restricted-counit transpose composed with the U unit is the W unit. Apply to exact restriction and pinned pullbacks. The q comparisons preserve units, so precomposing the two proposed restriction composites with the exact U unit gives equal maps. Underived open direct image is fully faithful and preserves K-injectives as right adjoint to exact restriction; the library fully-faithful right-derived-functor instances give full faithfulness after derivation. The triangle identity makes restriction to U of its unit invertible, and nested exact restriction composition then makes restriction to W of the U unit invertible. Use the W adjunction Hom equivalence to cancel this mapped unit after composing with qW.inv. This proves r≫qW.hom=qU.hom≫b. Map by Rf′ and cancel the U direct-image comparison and its inverse. The Lean proof first proves this calculation for arbitrary typed scheme factorizations and then specializes to the chosen pullback inclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMVInverseOpenIso_restriction {X X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (f' : X' ⟶ S') {W U : X.Opens} (i : W ≤ U) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
        (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X'
          ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g'.base).map (homOfLE i))
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ U))
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) K') ≫
      (relativeMVInverseOpenIso g' f' W K').hom =
    (relativeMVInverseOpenIso g' f' U K').hom ≫
      relativeMVRestriction (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' W.ι)
        (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) f' K'
